outcome: Number of red blood cell units per transfused patient
Number of red blood cell units per delivery
cohort: 7,234 women who delivered at three large regional hospitals in the Eastern Cape, South Africa, from February to June 2013
finding: The study found high rates of peripartum transfusion in South African hospitals, but the association between transfusion and HIV status was no longer significant after adjusting for other factors.
mod_finding: In a multivariate analysis controlling for other factors, there was no significant association found between peripartum transfusion and mode of delivery.
